statistics.note: households / population as printed in the 2022–2023 community-boundary announcements (status observed; reference date not stated).

verified.description: Point of an OpenStreetMap feature whose own name matches the official community name (Overpass: all named features in the municipality bbox, OSM base 2026-11-04T01:49:58Z; Nominatim bounded search per community). Name rules after Thai normalisation (NFC, Thai digits -> Arabic, ร.พ./รพ. -> โรงพยาบาล, punctuation/whitespace removed): N1 name equals the official name; N2 place=*/landuse=residential named the official name without 'ชุมชน'; N3 name contains the full official name ending at a word break. A tone/diacritic-insensitive-only match lowers confidence one level; only high/medium are accepted. Location rules: inside the OSM municipality polygon AND inside or within 150 m of the assigned (approximate) zone polygon; ways/relations must have a bbox diagonal <= 800 m. Ambiguity: rejected when accepted candidates are > 300 m apart or one OSM object matches several communities equally.

illustrative.description: DEMONSTRATION PLACEMENT, NOT A LOCATION: deterministic, evenly spread points inside each community's assigned zone polygon (the zones themselves are an approximate demonstration partition, hatyai-zones-approx). 25 m hexagonal candidate lattice restricted to >= 60 m from the zone and municipality edges and >= 120 m from verified points; farthest-point (maximin) initialisation with the boundary weighted as half a spacing; 12 iterations of discrete centroidal-Voronoi (Lloyd) relaxation with verified points held fixed; communities assigned to positions in SHA-256(nameTh) order (deliberately non-geographic); a jitter of up to 12% of the nominal spacing seeded by SHA-256(nameTh), accepted only if all constraints still hold. Only the zone membership of these points is real.

limitations: Illustrative points carry no information about where a community actually is inside its zone; do not use them for distance, exposure or routing analysis.
Zone polygons are an approximate demonstration partition (not official legal boundaries), so even zone membership near zone edges is approximate.
Verified points may be facilities named after the community (e.g. a community health post) rather than a surveyed community centroid; see properties.locationKind.
households/population are printed figures from the 2022–2023 boundary announcements (some flagged anomalies are kept as published, see properties.statsAnomalies).
